item.text: {"judgments":[{"concept_id":"TG:C3999db423bd9e1","equivalence":"equivalent","canonical_fit":"supported","problem_members":[],"reason":"两者均指自供能人体体温监测；腕部与额头的佩戴位置不改变应用概念。"},{"concept_id":"TG:Ca33ee8b3c0c7d9","equivalence":"equivalent","canonical_fit":"supported","problem_members":[],"reason":"两者均指生物相容性；材料对象和标注角色不同不改变该性质。"},{"concept_id":"TG:C488b365b066e7b","equivalence":"equivalent","canonical_fit":"supported","problem_members":[],"reason":"两者均指热电化学电池中的空间温度梯度，作用对象不同不构成概念差异。"},{"concept_id":"TG:C1c56d67ea43fbf","equivalence":"equivalent","canonical_fit":"supported","problem_members":[],"reason":"两处原文均明确描述凝胶的高透明性，定义未附加材料或形成机制限制。"},{"concept_id":"TG:C450715621df7b1","equivalence":"equivalent","canonical_fit":"supported","problem_members":[],"reason":"两者均指离子扩散过程；促进与抑制是不同条件下的关系方向，并非成员概念本身相反。"},{"concept_id":"TG:C999ed297b55db0","equivalence":"equivalent","canonical_fit":"supported","problem_members":[],"reason":"两者均明确指氧化还原活性；配合物与水凝胶是该性质的不同载体。"},{"concept_id":"TG:C2bcee9fa88feef","equivalence":"equivalent","canonical_fit":"supported","problem_members":[],"reason":"三个成员均指电极间距这一几何参数；实验、模型及性能响应差异不改变参数身份。"},{"concept_id":"TG:C6a160a3e4c4c73","equivalence":"equivalent","canonical_fit":"supported","problem_members":[],"reason":"全部成员均明确指热电化学效应这一通用机制；具体氧化还原反应及耦合效应不同，未将热扩散、压阻等机制并入该概念。"},{"concept_id":"TG:C1adc7a4fbd83dd","equivalence":"equivalent","canonical_fit":"supported","problem_members":[],"reason":"两者均指器件的储能功能，具体实现方式不同不改变通用功能概念。"},{"concept_id":"TG:C03d108deef061d","equivalence":"equivalent","canonical_fit":"supported","problem_members":[],"reason":"两处均明确指分隔高低温电极且阻隔该氧化还原对的离子交换膜类别；归一为该类别不要求膜的具体组成相同。"}]}
